name: Travel Agency Operations
audience: independent travel advisors and boutique travel agencies
topic: supplier confirmations and traveler readiness for travel agencies

products.name: Supplier Confirmation Chaser
products.product: A focused travel supplier confirmation tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent travel advisors and boutique travel agencies
products.problem: A client itinerary can look booked while hotel, transfer, activity, or special-request confirmations remain pending in supplier email threads.
products.valueProposition: Turns travel supplier confirmation tracking into a visible operating queue so every itinerary component has a supplier confirmation, matching terms, and an owner for unresolved differences.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets travel supplier confirmation, travel booking confirmation tracker, travel agency operations workflow, and itinerary confirmation checklist searches.

products.name: Traveler Requirement Readiness
products.product: A focused travel document requirement readiness tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent travel advisors and boutique travel agencies
products.problem: Travelers receive scattered reminders for names, preferences, payments, supplier forms, and destination requirements without one minimum-data readiness view.
products.valueProposition: Turns travel document requirement readiness tracking into a visible operating queue so every traveler-facing booking requirement is acknowledged or completed by its supplier or departure cutoff without copying unnecessary sensitive data.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets travel document checklist, travel client document reminder, trip readiness tracker, and travel advisor workflow searches.
